road_hierarchy.meaning: Policy categorisation of desired street function and sharing of space. Moderation and possible motor-traffic closure are planning intentions.

source_evidence.page84: B4 and B4.1: the synthesis map expresses moderation intentions; structural axes require studies coordinated with the canton. Traffic calming can also occur without changing the speed limit.
source_evidence.page87: Footnote: implementation modalities must be determined in accordance with applicable legislation, functionality and procedures.

not_claimed: Traffic capacity or achieved modal split

pedestrian_link.meaning: Comfortable and secure pedestrian permeability connecting public spaces; implementation objective rather than completed-path certification.

source_evidence.page82: B2.1: create continuous secure pedestrian connections between neighbourhoods; routes must address railway, road and topographic barriers.
source_evidence.page83: B2.3 and B2.5: school route safety and lift feasibility/location studies remain separate actions.

cycle_axis.meaning: Structural cycling route objective under B2, not a completed dedicated cycle lane.

bus_axis.meaning: Structural bus axis objective under B3, including coverage, priority and service improvements; no timetable or current-service guarantee.

motorway.meaning: Network context; do not invent a motorway construction project.

parking_policy.meaning: Target satisfaction ratios of VSS parking needs for new construction or substantial renovation/transformation, implemented through plans d’affectation.

source_evidence.page80: Two zones reflect public-transport service and nearby built/services density; ranges adapted case by case to local conditions.
source_evidence.page85: B5.2: centre housing0–20%/jobs0–10%; outer housing10–30%/jobs0–10%. Minimise newly created spaces; implementation through A1.1 plans d’affectation.

not_claimed: Automatic application to every existing building

global_limits: Source is a 2024 approved strategic municipal plan. Projections and diagnostic vintages remain dated, not observed current conditions.
2040 modal-share targets in PDF78 are explicitly not guaranteed; no measured performance claim.
Neighbouring municipal indications are expressly indicative and require intercommunal coordination.
Use only exact original native line supports; no artificial connection of dotted glyphs, arrowheads, separated subpaths or erased gaps.
Native stroke widths and painted bands represent cartographic styling, not physical road widths; no buffers or parcel intersections from line thickness.
Frozen geographic registration, municipal scope and original whole-path support require independent verification per page.
Source precision stays NULL; no spatial qualification, private rights or municipal completeness inferred.
